correctness.rationale: For F_n bouquet of n labelled triangles, synchronous 3-color CCA and threshold-one GHM, all initial states correspond to center color c in {0,1,2} and a sequence of n ordered leaf-pair types from 9 choices. Since contact rules depend on *presence*, not multiplicity, the nonempty support subset S suffices for all time, giving exactly 3(2^9-1)=1533 universal finite symbolic cases. Reviewed source explicit symbolic transition algorithm; complete support census verifies C_n^5=C_n^2, G_n^7=G_n^4 and exact first periodic entry coefficient rows. Onto(s,n)=sum(-1)^j binom(s,j)(s-j)^n transforms the support counts to exact all-n formula: CCA D0=3*3^n,D1=3*6^n,D2=3*(9^n-6^n-3^n); GHM D0=3^(n+1)-2,D1=6^n+4^n-3^n,D2=9^n-3^n+1,D3=9^n-4^n+1,D4=9^n-6^n-3^n. Primitive 3-cycle configurations share identical update maps, 3*(3^n-1) states => 3^n-1 orbits; eventually enter 3-cycle iff one originally rainbow petal. Independent direct graph-neighborhood enumeration for all 3^(2n+1) initial states n=1,2,3 confirmed exact distribution and common periods. As n->infinity, CCA T->2 while GHM T uniform {2,3,4}. The all-n assertion follows from exact support quotient and symbolic count, not extrapolating n<=3.
